hassio_confirm.title: Home Inventory
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the Home Inventory App? This adds inventory sensors, actions and automation events.

user.title: Connect to Home Inventory
user.description: For Home Assistant Container/Core installs running the Home Inventory companion container. The API token is shown in the container log and stored in its data folder (integration_token).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Home Inventory App. Check that it is running.

abort.already_configured: Home Inventory is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Inventory is already set up.

data.sidebar_panel: Add an Inventory sidebar panel (not needed with the App, which has its own)
data.voice_notify: Also send voice answers to your phone
data.maintenance_notify: Send maintenance reminders to your phone
data.customer_notify_service: Message repair customers with (a notify action that reaches them, e.g. SMS or email)

data_description.voice_notify: When you ask where something is, the answer (with where it is) is also sent as a notification, so you don't have to ask again. "Which one did you mean?" questions aren't sent, only the final answer.
data_description.notify_service: The notify action that reaches your phone. The Home Assistant companion app adds one per phone, named mobile_app_ followed by the phone's name.
data_description.maintenance_notify: When equipment becomes due for service, a notification says what's due and which parts you still need (missing parts are also added to the shopping list, unless that's turned off in the App's settings).
data_description.customer_notify_service: Leave empty to send no customer messages. The customer's phone number or email address (from their record) is passed as the target, so use a notify action that takes one, such as an SMS gateway or the SMTP (email) integration.
data_description.customer_notify_statuses: The message says, for example: 'Hi Pat, your Toro mower (job RJ-0012) is ready for collection.'

error.notify_service_required: Choose the notification action to send answers and reminders to.
error.notify_service_unknown: There's no notify action with this name. Check the name under Developer tools → Actions (notify.…).

search.name: Search inventory
search.description: Searches the inventory (natural language allowed) and returns matching items with their locations.

query.name: Query
query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Where are my DeWalt batteries?"

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

get_item_location.name: Get item location
get_item_location.description: Returns where an item is, including its status and loans.

get_container_contents.name: Get container contents
get_container_contents.description: Returns what is inside a container.

container.name: Container
container.description: Container number, name or label code.

move_item.name: Move item
move_item.description: Moves an item into a container or to a location.

move_container.name: Move container
move_container.description: Moves a container (and everything in it).

adjust_quantity.name: Adjust quantity
